gate_a.criterion: V2-B >= 90 usable sequence-divergent and family-disjoint clusters
gate_a.note: Primary §4.3 reference-set definition. Stricter corpus-wide sensitivity also passed with V2-B=108.

gate_b.criterion: largest Pfam family <=25% of divergent clusters

gate_d.caveat: Gate D passes under the frozen rule, but nonlinear sequence-only signal remains strong. The representation experiment must therefore compare against a strong sequence-derived baseline rather than interpreting raw toxin discrimination as representation-specific.

selected_negative_control.rationale: Family-aware negatives provide the hardest available sequence-clean contrast and directly test whether representation-level performance extends beyond toxin-associated family membership.

closure_statement: The Tox-Prot census establishes adequate positive independence, family diversity, negative support, and non-trivial model-blind task geometry. Further census expansion is not justified. The project should proceed to freeze the toxin-representation experiment before observing any ESM, SAE, probe, or toxin-prediction statistic.
